faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Woodland Acres?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 houses listed in Woodland Acres. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Woodland Acres a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Woodland Acres from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Woodland Acres over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Woodland Acres compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Woodland Acres held 5.9% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Woodland Acres than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 13 to 9 (−30.8%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
